title: She Went Into The Underworld To Save A Boy, And A Dead Woman Took Over Her Body . . .
caption:
In Children Who Chase Lost Voices (2011), a lonely girl hears a strange song on her radio, meets a boy from a hidden world called Agartha, and loses him.
She follows her teacher underground to bring him back, and the price is her own body.

comment: Would you have let Morisaki bring Lisa back, or let her go? Why?
credit: Anime: Children Who Chase Lost Voices (2011)

segments.say: A little girl walks into the underworld to save a boy, and a dead woman takes over her *body*.
To see how it got here, go back to a lonely girl on a *hillside*.
Her dad is gone, her mom works nights, and her only friend is a *cat*.
Every day she climbs up here and tunes a tiny homemade radio to the *sky*.
One day it picks up a strange song, and she cannot get it out of her *head*.
Then she crosses a railroad bridge, and a giant beast is *waiting*.
She trips on the tracks, and it lunges *straight at her*.
That is when a stranger steps between her and the *beast*.
He says the beast's life is already coming to an *end*.
But it is not done yet, and the boy takes the hit to *save her*.
A train roars in, and he grabs her and leaps off the *bridge*.
She wakes up under the stars on a mountain ledge, with no idea how she got *there*.
The boy tells her to stay away from this mountain. Naturally, she *doesn't*.
His name is Shun. She patches up his arm, and they tune the radio *together*.
Neither of them can forget that song, the one that sounds like someone's heart turned into *sound*.
Then Shun tells her where he comes from. A place called *Agartha*.
At sunset he gives her a kiss and a blessing, and she turns into a *tomato*.

segments.text: Asuna, I just want you to live.

segments.say: That sounded a lot like a goodbye.
That night he sits alone under the stars, afraid, and reaches for the *sky*.
Next morning Asuna packs two lunches for her friend, and he never *shows*.
Then she hears a boy's body was found in the *river*.
Shun is dead, and she never got to say *goodbye*.
That is a lot for one kid to carry.
At school, a new teacher, Mr. Morisaki, tells an old myth about the *underworld*.
A man follows his dead wife underground, and loses her *forever*.
After class she corners him, and he pulls out an old *book*.
He says ancient guardians called the Quetzal Coatl watch a gate to a world beneath the *earth*.
That world is Agartha, and it can supposedly grant any wish, even bringing back the *dead*.
That evening her cat Mimi bolts down the tracks, and Asuna chases her into the *dark*.
Her search ends on a mountaintop, with a cloaked boy who looks just like *Shun*.
But he is not Shun, and he tells her to forget everything she *saw*.
Then armed soldiers show up and demand a key called the *Clavis*.
Asuna and the boy run into a cave, with soldiers right behind *them*.
She calls him Shun. He snaps back, I am not *Shun*.
Then a huge guardian beast wakes up, and he fights it with the glowing *key*.
But the soldiers catch up, and one of them is her own teacher, Mr. *Morisaki*.
Nobody saw that one coming.
Morisaki only joined these soldiers for one *reason*.

segments.text: My only goal is to bring my wife back to life.

segments.say: He asks if she wants the boy back too. She does not know, but she goes with *him*.
They dive into an ancient pool, and sink into the *dark*.
They wake up in Agartha, a hidden world of green meadows and old stone *ruins*.
Mimi turns up too, riding on Asuna's *shoulder* like she never left.
That night Morisaki dreams of his wife Lisa, begging him to live well after she is *gone*.
The next day, he calls the trip a journey to learn how to say *goodbye*.
He did not believe a word of it.
But someone was already hunting them.
Meanwhile, Agartha's council is furious about the surface people, and sends Shin after the *Clavis*.
Then Shin finds Asuna in a ruined city, just as a swarm of monsters closes *in*.
They all run for a crumbling bridge, and it collapses into a roaring *river*.
Morisaki finds them half drowned on the *bank*.
Together they reach a hidden village called Amoroto, where outsiders are *unwelcome*.
Its elder explains why. For hundreds of years, surface kings looted Agartha and left it in *ruins*.
Honestly, they have a point.
Morisaki asks how to bring back the dead, and the elder says it is *forbidden*.
The village says Mimi has done her duty. Asuna begs her not to *go*.
They leave at dawn, but soldiers from Amoroto hunt them down, and Shin draws a sword to hold them *off*.
While Shin holds the line, Morisaki leads Asuna to a cliff as tall as the *sky*.
They climb down a giant wall of stone, and Asuna *freezes*.
At the bottom, Morisaki tells her to go home. He takes the Clavis and goes *alone*.
Then he says it. Asuna, I want you to *live*.
Same words Shun used.
Alone, Asuna runs through a night full of red eyed *monsters*.
She survives until dawn, and Shin finds her in the *grass*.
At sunrise she finally admits it. He looks like Shun, but he is *Shin*.
Together they head for the edge of the world, and find a giant Quetzal Coatl who has come there to *die*.
Before it dies, it sings the same song Asuna heard on her *radio*.
That song was a goodbye all along.
At the Gate of Life and Death, Morisaki finally gets his chance. Lisa, come back to *me*.
Then Asuna walks in.
Light pours out of the gate, and a dead woman's soul slips into Asuna's *body*.
Morisaki screams his wife's name. Shin screams for *Asuna*.
For one moment, Morisaki gets what he begged for. Lisa is right there, talking to *him*.
Be careful what you wish for.
But every second Lisa stays, Asuna slips further *away*.
Shin screams her name and throws himself into the *light*.
Then the light fades, Lisa steps out, and the two of them get one last moment on the *grass*.
She tells him to find happiness, and this time he lets *go*.
Asuna wakes up in the grass, alive, and finally ready to say *goodbye*.
Back home, she calls out to her mom and heads out the *door*.
She lost Shun, but she is finally ready to say hello to a world without *him*.
